notes.title: Update 1.61
notes.notes:
A few small changes i've added, as well as one new major feature. 

Bugfixes:

[list]
[*] New Resolution fixes (So things dont look crushed together on smaller resolutions)
[*] A few Server bugs being fixed (Things that haven't been updated for the new servers)
[*] A few Account Registration fixes/changes
[*] A LOT of Level Editor bugs have been fixed
[*] Fixed Level 50 just trapping you on a black screen after beating the game
[*] Probably more but I forgot lol
[/list]

Additions:

[list]
[*] A few minor Level Editor additions

notes.title: Update 1.6: The Editor Update (3)
notes.notes:
Welcome to Update 1.6! This update has quite a few new features, but must notably (and the first thing I should mention), the Servers are back. I have to create new ones, meaning you guys need to create new accounts. Sorry about that, I'm just as mad as all of you about that entire situation.

Anyways, here's a list of new features!

[list]
[*]New Level Editor! Create and Upload levels with ease now, unlike before.
[*]Fixed an Xbox Controller bug where moving wouldn't start the timer
[*]Speaking of the timer, changed the timer formatting to Minutes : Seconds : Milliseconds instead of just displaying Milliseconds
[*]New Button Textures- I think they look nicer than before.
[*]New Mouse Cursor Changes- When hovering over a button, it will display a different cursor.
[*]New Leaderboard Sorting Options- Sort between All, Top 10, Bottom 10, and Reverse.
[*]New Option- Show All Levels on One Page
[*]New Option- Remove the "Apples: " part of the Apple Count, leaving just the count
[*]New Online Level Screen and improvements- You can now see other people's times and if they've completed an online level or not.
[*]Added the first Bonus Level
[*]Added Powerups! 
[*]A TON of UI adjustments and bugfixes
[/list]

If you see any bugs in this update, PLEASE tell me. Update 1.61 will release on either 4/9 or 4/12 depending on if I find a bug that affects literally everything in the game or not.

If you don't like this update, just wait until 1.7. I have so much planned for 1.7 relating to technical features and making the game fun...

notes.title: Update -10.59: The Texture Update
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Texture Update! Here's a brief rundown of all of the changes that the amazing, magestic update has:

1. Vaulted all grass- We felt as if grass had no need to be in the game anymore, so we vaulted it.
2. Vaulted Bricks- same as grass.
3. Changed some of the UI textures- the UI is much more user friendly now.
4. Vaulted Jeremy- we felt as if he was an offensive character to people who hate frogs.
5. Unfixed numerous features- the apple count, and the level text.
6. Probably more idk

notes.title: The Play Button Update (Update 1.511)
notes.notes:
DISCLAIMER: I am expecting this update to be kinda buggy, but at least you can play the game now, If you see a bug just report it.

There are so many bugfixes, but here's a few of the MAIN ones:
Made it so that apples now run on an entirely seperate variable, and this is how they work:
When you are playing a level, each level has an amount of apples collected before it actually sets your real number of apples to that number. Basically, if you restart, you won't keep the apples you collected, but if you beat the level, the apples are kept. The only way to keep apples in a level is by finishing the level
added new stat to stats menu: chickens killed with sir croakington
fixed that one gap in level 42 and 50
fixed moving platforms slowly pushing you off + not being able to move on them
Removed the ability to restart levels when you press R due to so many bugs that simply broke the entire game when you did.
Added Minimap to all levels!
Added New UI Customization Menu!
Levels Auto Completing by you doing nothing has been fixed

notes.title: Update 1.51
notes.notes:
Before you read the additions, I need you to know that [b]I have removed apples from the game until February 27th due to MAJOR exploits I have found with them.[/b]

A ton of new bugs and a few minor additions:
Organized Options Menu
Added New Playable Tutorial
Added New "Stronger Gravity" Mode- Lets you jump the same height, with stronger gravity. This is a beta feature, and some levels may not work with it.
Updated Terms of Service
New and improved Movement! Movement is now a lot smoother instead of being a little bit glitchy.

Bugfixes:
Weighted Platforms should now be consistent with ALL framerates
Keys are now uncollected upon death
Fixed the Speedrunning Timer (You can't get 0 ms now)
Fixed the Ice DLC's unlockability
Fixed ALL Physics Glitching:
          Groundpounding from high heights, groundpounding when you're 0.5x scale, and              platforms clipping you into walls.
After 3 years, Moving Platforms will no longer let you hang onto their sides when walking into them.
You can't double jump anymore unless you can press the spacebar at ungodly speeds

On February 27th, I will be releasing Update 1.511 which will return apples to the game. Sorry for the inconvinience, I need to work on the system.

notes.title: Update 1.5: The Battle Update
notes.notes:
After a few months, The Croaker finally enters a brand new era where you can brutally murder your friends in a kind, loving manner!

Update 1.5 is MASSIVE and it brings a TON of bugfixes (Over 50!) and new gamemode: Battle Mode. This is a Free for All gun game, with 5 rounds per game. After 5 rounds, the person who won the most rounds wins the entire game. Give it a try! It's in a HEAVY beta mode, so if you find bugs, report them.

Alongside Battle Mode, there is a TON of bugfixes. I literally can't even list all of them, that's how many. Probably the most notable ones are the fact that you can pause the game without moving and the Player Icon on Leaderboards actually matches your player. With that, there's also an updated save system and more!

Have fun with this new update!

notes.title: Update 1.44 - MASSIVE Bugfixes
notes.notes:
a list of over like 50 bugs were fixed. Alongside that, account registration [i]should[/i] be fixed, but if not then you can now continue as a guest. You'll notice the mode selector now, as well as an ammended Main Menu UI. The mode selector will be put into use in 10 days, when Bonus Levels and Battle Mode are released. 
Also, you can now play Level 50- you can now beat the game's storyline!

REMINDER- this is more of a beta bugfix update, as I was planning to release the entire update on the 22nd, but me and a few friends decided to just release it now because there was a lot of good fixes in here. So if there's a lot of stuff that's broken, then it will DEFINETLY be fixed by the 22nd.

notes.title: Update 1.99
notes.notes:
Welcome to Update 1.299. 
The servers have unfortunately been shut down, so you cannot save progress, upload levels, or register accounts.
On the bright side, you guys get your first look at Challenge Mode! The Challenge DLC will release before halloween. The Challenge DLC will release 15 new challenges for all of you to play, and will be available for $1. You guys get the Challenge Mode Demo, which has two challenges available.

WIth the sever shutdown, EVERYONE has lost their progress. Everyone. You will all have to re earn it when the servers come back around November 5th. I am incredibly sorry about this.
